```{python}
#| output: asis
import os
import pathlib
import yaml

# Run from repo root:
#   node scripts/export-cv-yaml.mjs
#   quarto render cv/cv.qmd --to pdf
project_root = pathlib.Path(".").resolve().parent
yaml_path = (project_root / "src" / "generated" / "cv.generated.yml").resolve()

if not yaml_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError("YAML not found: " + str(yaml_path))

cv = yaml.safe_load(yaml_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

fmt = os.environ.get("QUARTO_FORMAT", "").lower()
is_pdf = ("pdf" in fmt)

ROLE_DEFAULT = {
    "me": ["bold"],
    "student": ["underline"],
    "mentor": [],
    "corresponding": ["italic"],
}

def s(x):
    if x is None:
        return ""
    return str(x).strip()

def latex_escape(text):
    # minimal escape for names/titles in LaTeX
    t = s(text)
    t = t.replace("\\", "\\textbackslash{}")
    t = t.replace("{", "\\{").replace("}", "\\}")
    t = t.replace("&", "\\&")
    t = t.replace("%", "\\%")
    t = t.replace("$", "\\$")
    t = t.replace("#", "\\#")
    t = t.replace("_", "\\_")
    t = t.replace("^", "\\^{}")
    t = t.replace("~", "\\~{}")
    return t

def unique_keep_order(xs):
    seen = set()
    out = []
    for x in xs:
        if x not in seen:
            seen.add(x)
            out.append(x)
    return out

def author_emphasis(a):
    # per your schema: emphasis is optional override
    emp = a.get("emphasis", None)
    if isinstance(emp, list) and len(emp) > 0:
        return [str(x) for x in emp]

    roles = a.get("roles") or []
    derived = []
    for r in roles:
        derived += ROLE_DEFAULT.get(str(r), [])
    return unique_keep_order(derived)

def apply_emphasis(name, emphasis):
    # PDF: use LaTeX commands (more reliable than Markdown underline)
    # HTML: use <strong>/<u>/<em>
    if is_pdf:
        t = latex_escape(name)
        # underline inside, italic next, bold outside
        if "underline" in emphasis:
            t = "\\underline{" + t + "}"
        if "italic" in emphasis:
            t = "\\emph{" + t + "}"
        if "bold" in emphasis:
            t = "\\textbf{" + t + "}"
        return t
    else:
        t = s(name)
        if "underline" in emphasis:
            t = "<u>" + t + "</u>"
        if "italic" in emphasis:
            t = "<em>" + t + "</em>"
        if "bold" in emphasis:
            t = "<strong>" + t + "</strong>"
        return t

def authors_apa(authors):
    # authors: [{name, roles, emphasis?}, ...]
    if not authors:
        return ""
    names = []
    for a in authors:
        nm = s(a.get("name"))
        emp = author_emphasis(a)
        names.append(apply_emphasis(nm, emp))

    if len(names) == 1:
        return names[0]
    if len(names) == 2:
        return names[0] + " & " + names[1]
    return ", ".join(names[:-1]) + ", & " + names[-1]

def doi_url(doi):
    d = s(doi)
    if not d:
        return ""
    if d.startswith("http://") or d.startswith("https://"):
        return d
    return "https://doi.org/" + d

def pub_venue_line(pub):
    venue = s(pub.get("venue"))
    vol = s(pub.get("volume"))
    issue = s(pub.get("issue"))
    pages = s(pub.get("pages"))

    parts = []
    if venue:
        parts.append("\\emph{" + latex_escape(venue) + "}" if is_pdf else "*" + venue + "*")

    vi = ""
    if vol and issue:
        vi = vol + "(" + issue + ")"
    elif vol:
        vi = vol
    elif issue:
        vi = "(" + issue + ")"

    if vi:
        parts.append(latex_escape(vi) if is_pdf else vi)
    if pages:
        parts.append(latex_escape(pages) if is_pdf else pages)

    if not parts:
        return ""
    return ", ".join(parts) + "."

def pub_links_line(pub):
    links = pub.get("links") or {}
    doi = s(links.get("doi"))
    journal = s(links.get("journal"))
    pdf = s(links.get("pdf"))
    other = s(links.get("other"))

    out = []
    if doi:
        out.append("[DOI](" + doi_url(doi) + ")")
    if journal:
        out.append("[Journal](" + journal + ")")
    if pdf:
        out.append("[PDF](" + pdf + ")")
    if other:
        out.append("[Link](" + other + ")")

    if not out:
        return ""
    return " " + " ".join(out)

def talk_context_line(t):
    # (Optional) Session + location
    session = t.get("session") or {}
    sid = s(session.get("id"))
    sname = s(session.get("name"))
    location = s(t.get("location"))

    bits = []
    if sid or sname:
        if sid and sname:
            bits.append(sid + ": " + sname)
        else:
            bits.append(sid or sname)

    if location:
        bits.append(location)

    if not bits:
        return ""
    return " " + " - ".join(bits) + "."

def talk_links_line(t):
    links = t.get("links") or {}
    abstract = s(links.get("abstract"))
    slides = s(links.get("slides"))
    poster = s(links.get("poster"))
    video = s(links.get("video"))
    other = s(links.get("other"))

    out = []
    if abstract:
        out.append("[Abstract](" + abstract + ")")
    if slides:
        out.append("[Slides](" + slides + ")")
    if poster:
        out.append("[Poster](" + poster + ")")
    if video:
        out.append("[Video](" + video + ")")
    if other:
        out.append("[Link](" + other + ")")

    if not out:
        return ""
    return " " + " ".join(out)

def heading(title):
    print("")
    print("## " + title)
    print("")
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Positions")

for p in cv.get("positions", []) or []:
    start = s(p.get("start"))
    end = s(p.get("end"))
    role = s(p.get("role"))
    org = s(p.get("org"))
    location = s(p.get("location"))

    date = (start + "-" + end + ": ") if (start or end) else ""
    loc = (" (" + location + ")") if location else ""

    if is_pdf:
        line = "- " + latex_escape(date) + "\\textbf{" + latex_escape(role) + "}, " + latex_escape(org) + latex_escape(loc)
    else:
        line = "- " + date + "**" + role + "**, " + org + loc
    print(line)
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Publications")

pubs = cv.get("publications", []) or []
for pub in pubs:
    a = authors_apa(pub.get("authors", []))
    y = s(pub.get("year"))
    title = s(pub.get("title"))

    if is_pdf:
        line = ""
        if a:
            line += a + ". "
        if y:
            line += "(" + latex_escape(y) + "). "
        line += latex_escape(title) + ". "

        tail = pub_venue_line(pub)
        if tail:
            line += tail

        line += pub_links_line(pub)
        print("- " + line.strip())
    else:
        line = ""
        if a:
            line += a + ". "
        if y:
            line += "(" + y + "). "
        line += title + ". "

        tail = pub_venue_line(pub)
        if tail:
            line += tail

        line += pub_links_line(pub)
        print("- " + line.strip())
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Honors and Awards")

for h in cv.get("honors_and_awards", []) or []:
    year = s(h.get("year"))
    title = s(h.get("title"))
    org = s(h.get("org"))

    if is_pdf:
        line = ""
        if year:
            line += latex_escape(year) + ": "
        line += latex_escape(title)
        if org:
            line += " - " + latex_escape(org)
        print("- " + line)
    else:
        line = ""
        if year:
            line += year + ": "
        line += title
        if org:
            line += " - " + org
        print("- " + line)
```


```{python}
#| output: asis
heading("Conferences and Presentations")

talks = cv.get("talks", []) or []
for t in talks:
    a = authors_apa(t.get("authors", []))
    y = s(t.get("year"))
    date = s(t.get("date"))
    title = s(t.get("title"))
    event = s(t.get("event"))
    kind = s(t.get("kind"))
    role = s(t.get("role"))

    # APA-like talk format:
    # Authors. (Year). Title. Event. [Kind; Role]. Session/Location. Links
    if is_pdf:
        line = ""
        if a:
            line += a + ". "
        if y:
            line += "(" + latex_escape(y) + "). "
        line += latex_escape(title) + ". "
        if event:
            line += "\\emph{" + latex_escape(event) + "}."
        if kind or role or date:
            tag = []
            if date:
                tag.append(date)
            if kind:
                tag.append(kind)
            if role:
                tag.append(role)
            line += " [" + latex_escape("; ".join(tag)) + "]."

        line += talk_context_line(t)
        line += talk_links_line(t)
        print("- " + line.strip())
    else:
        line = ""
        if a:
            line += a + ". "
        if y:
            line += "(" + y + "). "
        line += title + ". "
        if event:
            line += "*" + event + "*."
        tag = []
        if date:
            tag.append(date)
        if kind:
            tag.append(kind)
        if role:
            tag.append(role)
        if tag:
            line += " [" + "; ".join(tag) + "]."

        line += talk_context_line(t)
        line += talk_links_line(t)
        print("- " + line.strip())
```
